entries.description: OpenAPI 3.1 description of the Choreo Planer REST API for choreography, teams, clubs, members, positions, lineups, seasons and season-team assignments. Human-readable documentation is served at https://api.choreo-planer.de/api-docs.
representativeQueries: how do I create a choreography through the Choreo Planer API
which endpoints does the Choreo Planer REST API expose
how do I manage cheer club members and positions via the API

entries.description: Model Context Protocol server exposing Choreo Planer to agents. It covers the choreo, team, club, member, position, lineup, season and season-team services. Access requires a JWT bearer token, obtained as described at https://api.choreo-planer.de/auth.md.
representativeQueries: create a new choreography for my cheer team
show the seasons of my cheerleading club
assign positions and counts to a lineup using an agent
export a countsheet as PDF or video
